anomalies.message: CPU load average is high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or a bottleneck.

Trading metrics show no active trades or profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load.

Review and potentially reactivate trading strategies to ensure the platform is actively trading.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and mitigate any bottlenecks or inefficient processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting user experience and trading operations.

recommendations.action: Review AI module configurations and ensure it is properly set up to generate opportunities and make adjustments.
